steps.title: Keys for every part
steps.text: Shift+L loops the part you hear, N and Shift+N move to the next or previous part, Backspace goes back to its start.

steps.title: Your keys and pedals
steps.text: Preferences, then Change shortcuts and foot pedals: choose your own keys and set up a two-pedal page turner.

steps.title: Hands off the page
steps.text: Score shows the sheet music; the bar you hear is marked and the page turns by itself.
